motion_review.observed: Static seated wide shot with a slow push-in. A woman (left) and a man (right) sit across a round wooden table in a bright room with windows. Both hold fanned hands of cards and look at them; the man rearranges his hand. Small face-up spreads of cards lie in front of each player, and a closed card box and a vase of flowers sit on the table.

Cards on the table in front of each player
No chips, money or betting visible
contradicts: Both players hold fanned hands (War players do not hold hands)
Face-up spreads look like melds in a rummy-type game
No separate face-down draw piles visible
No simultaneous flip-and-compare seen in the 9 s
war_evidence.verdict: Not War. Usable only as a clearly labeled generic card-game fallback.
